title: SuperGem
description: Add a new ore, new capacities, new miniboss
body:
# 💎 SuperGem![new mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f56e6a3f5339c501aae91e8426deb87eea82ca11.png)![new ore!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b7997d725940c645f34a7a545bd0f2fa959fded.png)

![new GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82d95a8f989d6083046b711dd5838af348d67b30.png)



Welcome to **SuperGem**! This mod introduces unique elements, powerful mechanics, and dangerous entities to completely enhance and refresh your Minecraft survival experience.

---

## ✨ Features

### ⛏️ New Ore: Super Gem
* **Discovery:** Explorable and rare resource hidden deep within the underground world.
* **Utility:** Mine it to craft high-tier, powerful gear, weapons, and tools with enhanced durability.

### ⚡ Power Menu
* **Abilities:** Gain access to a custom interface granting game-changing special abilities.
* **Powers Included:** Master **Time Stop** to freeze your enemies or use **Fire Resistance** to survive the deepest Nether lakes.

### 👾 New Mob
* **Encounter:** A brand-new unique creature roaming your world. 
* **Behavior:** Explore your biomes to discover its custom drops, behaviors, and fighting style.
